title: Zenith Performance SMP
description: Modpack optimized for SMP, with performance and quality of life improvements without altering the vanilla experience.
body:
The **Zenith Performance SMP**  is a modpack designed to **improve performance** ⚡ and the player experience without modifying the essence of vanilla Minecraft.
It includes fundamental optimizations such as **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **Krypton**, which increase stability, reduce lag, and allow for smoother gameplay on both clients and servers.

In addition, it adds client-side improvements aimed at immersion and player comfort, such as **Immersive UI**, **Ambient Sounds**, and **Presence Footsteps**, along with other quality-of-life tweaks that enrich the experience without adding complexity.

The modpack is specially designed for **SMP** 👥, offering a lightweight, stable, and enjoyable environment without altering the original gameplay.

Performance on low-end hardware 🔍


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### **FPS**
### 
Test performed with the same graphics settings (12 render chunks, 10 simulation chunks):

**Minecraft Vanilla**: **_37–40 FPS_**

**Mascapitos Performance SMP**: **_110–113 FPS_** 🚀

  The modpack was tested on extremely modest hardware:
  **Intel Celeron N4500**, **4GB DDR4 3200MHz**, and integrated **Intel graphics** (very limited).
  Even so, it achieved surprisingly high performance.


</details>


The improvement shows that the modpack is optimized for the best possible performance even on very limited hardware.
